purpose: Teach: どー/ふまえ/別名/つきあい/帯び/一端/つた/しから

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: つたない文章でごめんね。リク、どーしたんだよ?
lines.en: Riku — what's going on with you?
lines.style: Quick, concerned. Slight lean forward. Tone shifts from teasing to genuine in the span of one sentence. Eye contact seeking.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、先生のご助言をふまえて勉強した?桜
lines.en: Did you actually study like the teacher suggested, Sakura?
lines.style: Quiet probe. Not accusatory — genuinely asking. Measured pace. Slight distance in his voice, testing whether she'll be honest with him.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前のあだ名って別名で何だっけ?
lines.en: Wait — what was that nickname everyone calls you again?
lines.style: Playful deflection. Lightening the moment. Mock-thoughtful pause before asking, like he knows the answer but wants her off-guard in a gentle way.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前とのつきあい、もう何年だ?桜
lines.en: How many years have we known each other now, Sakura?
lines.style: Slower. Thoughtful. Like he's counting it up in his head as he speaks. Soft, almost to himself, but clearly meant for her to hear and understand the weight of it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、汗を帯びたユニフォーム、洗えよ
lines.en: Your uniform's soaked through. Wash it, will you?
lines.style: Dry, matter-of-fact delivery. The care underneath completely covered by practicality. Quick flick of a smile that says he's not actually annoyed.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前の活躍は部活成功の一端だぜ、桜
lines.en: You're part of why the club's doing this well, Sakura.
lines.style: Straightforward, no performance. Solid eye contact. Says it like a fact, not a compliment — which somehow makes it land harder. Brief pause after her name.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前の感謝、ぼくに伝ったぜ
lines.en: Your thanks — it got to me, you know?
lines.style: Quiet. A little caught off-guard by his own sincerity. Soft completion to the thought, like he's admitting something he didn't plan to say out loud.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、しからずに、優しく教えてくれ、桜
lines.en: Don't lecture me — just teach me gently, okay?
lines.style: Vulnerable request beneath a calm surface. Slower pace on the first clause. Slight lift at the end — not quite a question, but not fully settled either. Exposed.
